message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18, 1815, resulted in roughly **48,000–50,000 total casualties** when you combine the losses of both sides:

| Side | Approximate casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| Allied (British, Dutch, Belgian, Prussian) | ~23,000 |
| French | ~25,000 |

These figures include killed, wounded, and missing soldiers. The exact numbers vary slightly among historians, but the consensus places the combined toll at around half a hundred thousand.
